approach: The bush seems... ancient. Wise. Aware.
Leaves rustle with purpose. With memory.
You feel the weight of ages. From shrubbery.
Is that... recognition in the branches?
A voice on the wind. Or from the leaves?
reveal: I am old. Older than the temple. Older than the mountain's name.
My cousin in Dustbelt is young. Impatient. But learning.
The mountain remembers. I am its memory.
You seek what was lost. I know where.
rumor: The earth here is alive. Listening. Waiting.
The twins do not know they channel old power. Ancient.
The black coat's secrets are not his own. Borrowed. Dangerous.
When the final star aligns, the mountain will sing.
dialog.quest_hook: Seeds from the First Tree. Sleeping. Need planting where three winds meet. Ancient place. Forgotten place. Plant them. Life returns.
dialog.quest_active: Three winds. Peak of the Tri-Wind Point. Plant deep. Speak the old words. Growth will come.
dialog.quest_complete: You planted. The First Tree's children grow. The mountain thanks you. Here. My essence. Carry it. Ancient protection.
dialog.wisdom: All things grow. All things fade. Only the mountain remains. And me.

party_reactions.kade: Wait. Is the bush...? No. Couldn't be. ...Is it?
party_reactions.nix7: Anomaly detected. Botanical age: exceeds parameters.
party_reactions.twist: HELLO OLD BUSH! You're VERY BUSHY!
party_reactions.korr: Elder one. I sense your age. Your wisdom.

mini_quest.title: Three Seeds
mini_quest.description: Plant ancient seeds from the First Tree where three winds meet

stages.hook: Seeds from the First Tree. Sleeping. Need planting where three winds meet. Ancient place. Plant them. Life returns to old places.
stages.active: Tri-Wind Point. Peak location. Three winds converge. Plant deep. Speak to the earth. Growth will answer.
stages.complete: You planted well. First Tree's children grow. Mountain remembers. Take my essence. Ancient protection. Rare gift.
